topic.title: Is PPF alone enough to build a big retirement fund over 20 years

title: PPF is safe, but is it enough for retirement?
description: ₹1.5 lakh put in once for 20 years: PPF at an assumed 7.1% against an index fund at an assumed 11%. Both are assumptions and index returns are not assured. Illustrative only. Not financial advice.
cta: Tell us your retirement plan below
